name: or_tokens
label: OpenRouter tokens (total)
definition: Prompt + completion tokens routed to the model in the period, summed across apps.

name: or_tokens_prompt
label: OpenRouter prompt tokens
definition: Input tokens, where the export separates them.

name: or_tokens_completion
label: OpenRouter completion tokens
definition: Output tokens, where the export separates them.

name: or_app_tokens
label: OpenRouter tokens by app x model
definition: Tokens a named app sent to a model. Entity id is '<app_id>|<model_id>'.

name: or_token_share
label: OpenRouter token share
definition: or_tokens / sum of or_tokens over all models in the period (models in the ranking only).

name: or_n_apps
label: Number of ranked apps using model
definition: Distinct apps with positive or_app_tokens for the model in the period.

name: or_top_app_share
label: Share of model tokens from its largest app
definition: Concentration check: max over apps of or_app_tokens / or_tokens.

name: gh_new_repos
label: New public repos mentioning provider
definition: GitHub repository-search total_count for the provider query restricted to repos created in the month.

name: gh_new_repos_all
label: All new public repos (normaliser)
definition: total_count of all repositories created in the month; denominator for gh_new_repos_share.

name: gh_new_repos_share
label: Provider share of new repos
definition: gh_new_repos / gh_new_repos_all.

name: pypi_downloads
label: PyPI downloads (no mirrors)
definition: Daily downloads of the SDK package excluding mirrors.

name: npm_downloads
label: npm downloads
definition: Daily downloads of the SDK package from the npm registry.

name: sdk_downloads
label: SDK downloads (PyPI + npm, provider)
definition: Sum of first-party SDK package downloads mapped to the provider.

name: hf_downloads_30d
label: HF downloads, rolling 30 days
definition: Value of `downloads` at snapshot time (rolling 30-day window ending that day).

name: hf_downloads_alltime
label: HF downloads, all-time
definition: Cumulative downloads at snapshot time.

name: hf_likes
label: HF likes
definition: Cumulative likes at snapshot time.

name: hf_n_derivatives
label: HF derivative models (lower bound)
definition: Count of repos tagged base_model:<repo>; capped by page limit so a lower bound.

name: hf_downloads_period
label: HF downloads in period (derived)
definition: First difference of hf_downloads_alltime between consecutive period-end snapshots.

name: disc_tokens_per_day
label: Disclosed tokens processed per day
definition: Tokens per day as stated; convert monthly figures by /days only when the source states the period.

name: disc_tokens_per_month
label: Disclosed tokens processed per month
definition: Tokens per month as stated.

name: disc_revenue_runrate_usd
label: Disclosed AI revenue run-rate
definition: Annualised revenue run-rate as stated (not GAAP).

name: disc_revenue_usd
label: Disclosed AI/cloud revenue for period
definition: Recognised revenue for the stated period (segment where available).

name: disc_api_revenue_share
label: API share of revenue
definition: API/developer revenue as share of total, as stated.

name: disc_customers
label: Disclosed business customers
definition: Paying business/API customers as stated.

name: disc_developers
label: Disclosed developers
definition: Developers/API users as stated (definition varies; keep quote).

name: disc_weekly_users
label: Disclosed weekly active users (consumer)
definition: Consumer WAU as stated; context only, not API demand.

name: cn_tokens_per_day
label: Announced daily token calls (CN)
definition: Daily token volume announced by a Chinese provider or cloud platform.

name: cn_platform_rank
label: Platform ranking position (CN)
definition: Ordinal position on a named Chinese ranking (store ranking name in note).

name: cn_enterprise_customers
label: Announced enterprise customers (CN)
definition: Enterprise customers announced.

name: ext_firm_adoption_rate
label: Share of firms using AI (official survey)
definition: Statistical-office survey share of firms using AI; store country/wave.

name: ext_job_postings
label: Job postings mentioning provider/model
definition: Postings that mention the provider or SDK, from a named job-board dataset.
